summary: Comprehensive testing of Centralized Attendance Dashboard module. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified working including summary cards, center-breakdown table, employee detail view, edit dialog (Super Admin), and trends charts. Fixed critical Edit Dialog bug (SelectItem empty value error) and React duplicate key warning.

minor.issue: Returns duplicate center code PB-PERTH (data issue - two centers with same code in MongoDB)

issues: Recharts warning: width/height -1 on initial render - charts need explicit dimensions or parent container height

Backend: /summary returns overall attendance stats with present/absent/half_day/week_off/leave/attendance_percentage
Backend: /summary without date defaults to today
Backend: /summary returns 401 for invalid token
Backend: /center-breakdown returns per-center attendance with alert status (red/yellow/green)
Backend: /center-detail returns employee-level attendance for selected center
Backend: /monthly-trend returns daily attendance trend for a month
Backend: /center-comparison returns monthly comparison across centers
Backend: /export returns Excel file for daily attendance
Backend: /export-monthly returns Excel file for monthly attendance
Backend: /export with center filter works
Backend: /edit allows Super Admin to edit attendance
Backend: /edit rejects invalid status codes (400)
Backend: /edit returns 401 for invalid token
Backend: Access control - requests without token rejected
Frontend: Page loads with data-testid='attendance-dashboard-page'

Frontend: Super Admin badge displayed
Frontend: Summary cards display (Total, Present, Absent, HalfDay, WeekOff, Leave, Attendance %)
Frontend: Attendance Distribution pie chart renders
Frontend: Center-wise Breakdown table with all columns
